notes.title: Level Design Rework v1.2
notes.content:
[b]Level Design Rework[/b]
Everything on the map has been redesigned, aiming for a more linear flow to make it clearer and easier to jump into. But of course it's still possible to take alternative routes for speedrun. Overall, the gameplay experience has been smoother and more consistent from the start.

[b]Checkpoint System[/b]
Now, when the last chekpoint is loaded, the flying objects return to their original position. This allows flying objects to be a much more intense part of the level design. In other hand with this change no chekpoint gameplay is now much more challenging and punishing. Sometimes you will only get one chance.

[b]New Models and Revisions[/b]
Several new models have been added to the game and some models have been redesigned. Some of these are cosmetic and some have a direct impact on gameplay.

[b]Enemies[/b]
Now you'll encounter enemies in many more places and, as usual, they won't let you off the hook easily. 

[b]No More FPS Limit[/b]
Previously the game was locked to 60 FPS. Some simple calculations that should have been in place from the start have finally been added to the character's movement system and this limit is no longer necessary. 

[b]Music[/b]
There is a new soundtrack in the game. You can turn it off in the options menu.

[b]User Experince Improvments[/b]
Some sounds and animations have been added to make it easier to understand what is happening in the game.

notes.title: New Skins and Platforming Elements v1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047960/f9406df5ddb5c2be3f6b776a325f31d55f7a6b34.png[/img]There are 8 new playable balls . These are just skins, they have no effect on gameplay.
    • Tennis
    • Soccer
    • Volleyball
    • Beach Ball 
    • Bowling Ball
    • The Earth 
    • Baseball
    • Golf Ball

Added new collision sounds for balls made of hard materials.

New Platforming Elements
    • Open/Close Ground
    • Piston
    • Robotic Arm with Platform

The Nova Station section of the map has been revised. The parkours were rebuilt and some level art updates.

The system that checks whether the ball is in the air works more precisely. The ball's movement is now much more predictable and stable.

The system that limits the ball's speed has been revised. The calculation for the X and Y axes has changed and they no longer reduce the ball's already gained momentum. The speed is no longer limited on the Z axis. The ball can bounce higher, but it also falls to the ground much faster.

Lighting Improvements
